job.job_description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer who is passionate about quality, curious about how systems work, and eager to learn both manual and automation testing.

This role is open to freshers as well as candidates with up to 3 years of experience who have strong analytical thinking, good communication skills, and a problem-solving mindset.

You will work closely with product, development, and business teams to understand requirements, test applications, identify issues, and ensure high-quality releases.

Location: Indore

Key Responsibilities
Understand business requirements, user stories, and application workflows
Design, write, and execute test cases and test scenarios (manual + basic automation)
Perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing
Identify, document, and track bugs with clear reproduction steps
Collaborate with developers and product teams to resolve issues efficiently
Participate in requirement reviews and provide QA perspective early in the cycle
Support automation efforts (learning/working on tools like Selenium)
Perform basic API testing (Postman/REST/SOAP)
Validate data using basic SQL queries
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and practices
Assist in root cause analysis and troubleshooting issues
Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
0 3 years of experience (Freshers with strong fundamentals can apply)
Strong understanding of software testing concepts (SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycle)
Good analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to understand business logic and workflows quickly
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Basic understanding of:
Manual testing techniques
API testing concepts
Databases (SQL basics)
Familiarity with tools like JIRA or similar bug tracking tools
Good to Have (Not Mandatory)
Exposure to automation tools (Selenium or similar)
Basic programming knowledge ( Java / JavaScript / HTML / CSS )
Experience or understanding of Agile/Scrum
Awareness of Git/GitHub
Understanding of non-functional testing (performance, security basic level)

What We re Looking For
A curious mindset someone who asks why and what if
Strong attention to detail and ownership of work
Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced environment
Someone who thinks beyond test cases and focuses on product quality
A team player who communicates clearly and collaborates effectively

Growth Opportunity


This role is ideal for candidates who want to grow into:

Automation Engineer
SDET
Product/Quality Analyst

You will get hands-on exposure to real-world systems, business workflows, and modern QA practices .
